tour.welcomeDescription: You're about to explore how Johnson & Johnson - a $89B company with 138,000 employees - could run on self-management. This demo is populated with real public J&J data.
tour.newspaperDescription: Every morning, this is what you see. A living newspaper of your organization - featured knowledge, recent meetings, active tensions, and to-dos.
tour.memoryDescription: Every piece of knowledge - from board meetings to R&D reports - is automatically processed by AI into a searchable encyclopedia.
tour.structureDescription: Instead of departments and managers, the organization runs on circles - self-governing teams with clear purposes and distributed authority.
tour.decisionsDescription: Proposals turn tensions into action through consent-based governance. No politics, no management committees - just reasoned objections.
tour.askDescription: The AI assistant knows everything in the Brain. Ask it about any topic, draft proposals, or get context for decisions.
tour.exploreDescription: Tour complete! You now have full access to explore Johnson & Johnson's governance through Corgtex. The workspace is read-only, but feel free to click around.
tour.briefingCtaTitle: Want to see this with your organization?
tour.briefingCtaDescription: We can walk through how Corgtex would map your AI workforce, governance, knowledge, and costs. You can schedule a briefing now or keep exploring the demo.

tour.welcomeDescription: This quick walkthrough shows where your team can find context, invite colleagues, connect tools, and watch trial AI usage.
tour.homeDescription: The home view collects recent knowledge, meetings, tensions, actions, and useful context so people can orient quickly.
tour.circlesDescription: Circles show the teams, roles, and accountabilities that shape how work gets done.
tour.tensionsDescription: Tensions are gaps between what is and what could be. They're the starting point for every improvement in a self-managed workspace.
tour.actionsDescription: Actions capture the concrete next steps that come out of meetings, tensions, and proposals. Assign owners, set due dates, and track completion.
tour.meetingsDescription: Upload transcripts or record meetings. Corgtex extracts summaries, action items, tensions, and follow-ups automatically.
tour.proposalsDescription: Tensions, proposals, goals, and actions keep change visible instead of buried in meetings or chat threads.
tour.goalsDescription: Goals align the workspace around shared objectives. Link proposals, actions, and tensions to goals for strategic clarity.
tour.mapsDescription: Context maps give a spatial view of how knowledge, people, and decisions connect across the workspace.
tour.agentGovernanceDescription: Set policies, model budgets, and review agent runs. AI Governance keeps autonomous agents accountable and within guardrails.
tour.integrationsDescription: Connect Read.ai, Fathom, or Fireflies, or upload transcript exports so Corgtex can extract proposals, action items, and Brain context.
tour.assistantDescription: The assistant can use workspace context and enabled tools while respecting the current plan and AI budget.
tour.setupDescription: Add initial context before the workspace opens up, or start the tour first if you want to look around.
tour.setupReturnDescription: The tour is complete. Add files or meeting transcripts so the workspace has useful context to work from.
tour.checklistDescription: Complete these three steps to get the most out of Corgtex from day one.
tour.uploadDescription: Upload documents, paste text, or connect data sources to seed your workspace Brain.
tour.drivePickerDescription: Choose specific Google Docs, Sheets, or Slides for the first Brain sync.
tour.drivePickerConnectDescription: Connect selected-file Google Drive access, then Picker opens so you can choose files.
tour.drivePickerComplete: {count} Google Drive file(s) queued for sync.
tour.driveDescription: Connect Google Drive and select Docs, Sheets, or Slides to sync into the Brain.
tour.driveConnectNeeded: Connect Google Drive before selecting documents.
tour.driveScopeNeeded: Reconnect Google with document access to select Drive files.
tour.driveEmpty: No eligible Google Docs, Sheets, or Slides found.
tour.driveSyncQueued: Google Drive document sync is queued.
tour.driveErrorLoad: Could not load Google Drive documents.
tour.driveErrorSave: Could not sync selected Google Drive documents.
tour.connectRecorderDescription: Use exports from your current meeting recorder as the first onboarding source.
tour.recorderSetupReady: Choose Read.ai, Fathom, Fireflies, or upload transcript exports from any other recorder.
tour.recorderUnavailable: Meeting recorder setup is not available for this workspace yet.
tour.recorderEnabled: Meeting recorder is enabled. Connect a calendar or transcript source when you are ready.
tour.transcriptSourcesDescription: Use the recorder your team already has. Connect future sync or upload past transcript exports.
tour.transcriptSourcesReady: Read.ai uses webhook plus upload in V1. Fathom and Fireflies can use API keys for backfill and future sync.
tour.connectClientDescription: Already using Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor? Connect it so Corgtex can supply company context, policies, and write-back. If not, start with OpenWork.
tour.connectClientUnavailable: AI app setup is not available for this workspace yet.
tour.connectClientSelected: {provider} is selected. Connect it in a new tab, then return here to continue the tour.
tour.connectClientCopiedAndOpened: Copied the Corgtex MCP URL and opened {product} in a new tab.
tour.connectClientCopiedOnly: Copied the Corgtex MCP URL. If {product} did not open, use the setup link.
tour.connectClientOpenedCopyBlocked: {product} opened in a new tab, but clipboard access was blocked. Select and copy the MCP URL.
tour.connectClientOpenCopyBlocked: Could not open {product}, and clipboard access was blocked. Select and copy the MCP URL.
tour.connectClientCursorOpening: Opening Cursor's MCP installer. This Corgtex tour tab stays open.
tour.connectClientCursorFallback: Could not open Cursor automatically. Use the browser fallback.
tour.connectClientErrorSelect: Could not save the selected AI app.
tour.connectClientErrorVerify: Could not verify the AI app connection.
tour.connectClientErrorMark: Could not mark the AI app connected.
